task.title: Clear Cookies and Cache in Chrome
task.shortdesc: Clear your device's cookies and cache in Google Chrome.

context.p: These steps apply to Google Chrome. To clear your cookies and cache from Microsoft Edge or Safari, see the related links below.

step.cmd: At the top right, select MoreDelete browsing data.

step.stepxmp: For example, select Last hour or All time.

step.cmd: Select Cookies and other site data.
Select any other items you want to delete, such as Cached images and files.
